title: Recent claims need a current source
statement: Re-verify every dated claim and source on recent events against a current source before release: a curriculum bundle is no authority on what happened after its build date.
detail: The final unit specification of an AP history course warns that recent-history claims are especially drift-prone: every dated claim and source needs current verification before release, and the local curriculum bundle is a scope substrate, not perpetual authority for events after its build date. That unit's writing progression includes a current-source provenance check. It is a declared rule, not a measured one.
against: The specification is marked historical and superseded as a build instruction (UNIT-SPECS.md line 5), and the course's design documents record no run of the check.

evidence.quote: Recent-history claims are especially drift-prone. Every dated claim and source needs current verification before release; the local bundle is a scope substrate, not perpetual authority for events after its build date.
Causation with multiple time horizons; current-source provenance check; cumulative argument using evidence from at least three periods.
This file records the earlier plan-review and Unit 1 phase. It is not an active review request, build instruction, or submission contract.
